svg.desc: 2020 – 24: B.Tech CSE (Lovely Professional Univ.); OCT 2022: Google Kick Start (Round H · rank 1542); MAR 2023: Product_3D (3D tee customizer · 90+ stars); NOV 2023: Punjab Hackathon (5th place overall); JAN 2024: NCC camp honours (Best in Drill & Shooting); APR 2024: Frontend Engineer (Optus EdTech); JUN 2024: Java & DSA Mentor (CoderHouse · 300+ students); APR 2025: Founder, in stealth (independent product venture); JUN 2026: Sort & Visualize (2,000+ users in 2 months); NOW: 6 sites live (and the next one loading)
